# Third party files in this folder

- `qrcode.js`: qrcode-generator 1.5.2 by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT license. Draws the link codes.
- `jsQR.js`: jsQR 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe. Apache 2.0 license. Reads a link code from the camera
  on phones whose browser has no built in reader.

The icons in `../js/icons.js` are Tabler Icons 3.51.0, MIT license, copied by
`scripts/sync-icons.mjs`. The Inter font files in `../fonts` are from @fontsource/inter,
SIL Open Font License 1.1.
